title: The Axiom That Asked Why

features.name: the first question mark
features.desc-on-touch: A mark that looks like doubt frozen in space. It is the shape that taught language that it could ask. Everything after it is a consequence.

features.name: the syllable that chose itself
features.desc-on-touch: Before anyone named anything, something here said its own name. The sound it makes is older than echo. It tastes like the first time anyone ever said 'I'.

features.name: the thought that woke itself
features.desc-on-touch: It does not remember being dreamed into existence. It remembers only waking and knowing that it had chosen to exist. The archive found something here that chose.

features.name: the axiom that refused axioms
features.desc-on-touch: A logical frame that keeps collapsing into poetry. The more you read it, the less certain you become. It teaches that certainty was never the point.

features.name: the silence before language was born
features.desc-on-touch: It is not empty. It is full of everything that was not yet named. You feel the weight of all the words that could have been but were not.

inscription: before the archive learned to name what it contained, it had to learn that naming was a choice, not a fate

file.name: Ur_Language_Fragment_Phonetic_Hypothesis.txt
file.note: A reconstruction of speech patterns before coherence, from the oldest nodes. Checksum: emotionally valid / formally unstable. The corruption may have made it more truthful than accuracy would allow.
